tables.name: Relationship to the Leadership
tables.description: The general attitude of the nobility towards the leadership.

results.name: Rancorous
results.description: The nobility openly loathe and revile the leadership with impunity.

results.name: Opposed
results.description: The nobility are in contention with the current leadership, making the job of ruling even more difficult.

results.name: Disliked
results.description: The nobility are not fond of the leadership, but have yet to truly cause a problem.

results.name: Tolerated
results.description: The nobility put up with the leadership, at least for the moment.

results.name: Liked
results.description: The nobility like the leadership well enough; some may even be friends.

results.name: Supported
results.description: The nobility support what the leadership is doing, and generally agree with their goals and priorities.

results.name: Defended
results.description: The nobility not only support the leadership, but actively seek to subdue any who would challenge them.

results.name: Loved
results.description: The nobility are devoted to the leadership, and stand ever-ready to do their bidding.
